title: Lyon split-arc tracer fails for X > 1 (intersection table mostly null)
description:
Surfaced during PATCH-68 verification with synthetic X[i] sweep on Hand-30k:

  X=1: 39 quads (1 per Tpatch)
  X=2: 8 quads (expected 156 = 39 patches * 4 quads)
  X=3: 18 quads (expected 624)
  X=5: 45 quads (expected 1404)
  X=8: 73 quads (expected 3159)

Quads are dropped when ANY corner of a quad cell is null, and IntersectionTable.intersection3D returns null when no edge of arc1 shares a mesh face with any edge of arc2. With X=1, no interior arcs are needed (table corners are populated from Tpatch corner-nodes), so 39 patches → 39 quads. With X >= 2, interior split arcs must be traced via SplitArcTracer; their intersections must occur in shared mesh faces.

Metriko's reference X distribution on the same Hand mesh:
  total arcs: 352
  avg X: 3.32, max: 26
  histogram: X=1→164, X=2→67, X=3→39, X=4→14, X=5→7, X=6→10, X=7→7, X=8→12, X=9→8, X=10→5, X=11→6, X=15→2, X=17→1, X=19→2, X=20→1, X=21→1, X=22→1, X=24→3, X=25→1, X=26→1

With proper quantization + working tracer, expect ~2339 quads (matching metriko).

Likely fixes:
1. SplitArcTracer's direction calculation (atan / TRS rotation) is wrong, sending traced arcs into the wrong faces.
2. The same-face shortcut may be incorrect when arcs traverse multiple faces.
3. Numerical robustness in segment-segment intersect (EPS tuning).

Diagnostic to add: count successful vs null intersections per patch, dump the mesh faces traversed by sample arc1/arc2 pairs that fail to intersect.
definition-of-done: MetrikoStageRegressionTest.stage2UvsThroughLyonEndToEnd with synthetic X=3 produces > 300 quads (= ~75% of expected 39*16=624). X=8 produces > 1500 quads.
testing-plan: 1. Add per-patch null-intersection counter. 2. Dump face traversal of ~5 failing arc pairs to identify the bug. 3. Fix tracer direction calculation. 4. Re-run sweep.
